## Professional Profile

I am a mathematics student preparing for a career in education, with tutoring experience in mathematics and physics. My background in mathematics has strengthened my appreciation for the connections between ideas, and I want students to experience mathematics as something they can explore and make sense of. I aim to create supportive learning environments where students feel comfortable asking questions, sharing ideas, and learning from mistakes.
